why: Take or skip in disguise: taking value x earns x times its count but forbids x-1 and x+1, which is house robber over the values 1..max, where house v holds v * count(v).
hints: If you take one 4, should you take all the 4s? What does taking 4 forbid?
Taking value v (all copies) forbids v-1 and v+1: neighbours on the number line. Build points[v] = v * count(v).
Run house robber over points[1..max]: best = max(skip, take); take = skip + points[v]. O(n + max value).
pitfalls: Do not run house robber on the input order; adjacency is by value, not by position.
